attrs.evidence: proof_bundle.mjs / proof_check.mjs / proof_forgeries.mjs, gate `gov-proof`. x * (y + z) = (x * y) + (x * z) over {0,1,2,3}^3: 64 cases, 128 program sides, 128 native films. The checker DERIVES 64 assignments from the declared domains and matches them as a set -- 64 distinct, 0 missing, 0 duplicated, 0 outside the domain -- then re-derives all 128 chains from the proposition IN THE BUNDLE and reproduces every lowering, instantiation and emission receipt field for field, replays all 128 films on FloatRt and ScrambledFloatRt, and re-decodes all 128 outcomes from normal forms it reached itself. 64/64 cases reach DIFFERENT target terms and agree on the decoded outcome; 7 of them normalise past the SEMSTATE-CANONICAL-v1 signature-compaction bound, so the decoder retired at B8.1 could not have read their answers -- the widening is load-bearing for this artifact rather than done in advance. NON-VACUITY IS ITS OWN GATE: proof_forgeries.mjs mutates the bundle in memory 13 ways and requires each to draw ITS OWN refusal code, digesting before and after so a forgery that forged nothing FAILS rather than counting. The two that matter most are the aggregate RESEALED around its own duplicate -- internally consistent at every hash, refused by arithmetic -- and the domain widened WITH its id and expected count updated, which no hash check can see and the derived coverage refuses. Three further forgeries live in the negative battery against the checker's INDEPENDENCE, because those are invisible in a passing run: the checker importing the generator's enumeration, the checker reading the verdict instead of computing one, and the bounded scope leaving the artifact.
attrs.statement: A BOUNDED CLAIM IS A CLAIM ABOUT A DOMAIN, AND ITS EVIDENCE MUST BE CHECKABLE BY SOMETHING THAT TRUSTS NEITHER THE CLAIM NOR THE THING THAT PRODUCED IT. A BoundedProofBundle states a proposition, the finite variable domains it is claimed over, and one CaseEvidence per assignment carrying both sides' full compiler chain -- program identity, lowering receipt, instantiation receipt, emission receipt, native semantic film, target normal-form identity and decoded outcome -- plus an aggregate. THE VERDICT FIELD IS THE ONE THING A CHECKER MAY NEVER READ AS TRUE. An aggregate that certifies itself is derivation.instantiation-identity@1's defect at the END of the chain instead of the start: the object that produced the evidence would also be the thing saying the evidence is sufficient. The checker COMPUTES a verdict from its own refusals and compares the bundle's to it. THE DOMAIN IS DERIVED BY THE CHECKER, NOT READ FROM THE BUNDLE'S COUNT. Coverage is the Cartesian product the checker computes itself, by a DIFFERENT algorithm from the generator's -- mixed-radix index arithmetic against iterative expansion -- and matched as a SET. Importing the generator's enumeration would make 'the cases cover the domain' a tautology about one function agreeing with itself, which is the same shape as an emitter canonicalising its own output. A TOTAL IS NOT A COVERAGE. Sixty-four cases over sixty-three unique assignments is the exact shape a complete-looking bundle takes when it is short, and it survives every hash if the aggregate is resealed around the duplicate. Completed, distinct, missing and failed are recomputed and cross-checked by arithmetic; the case-set commitment is over the SORTED, UNDEDUPLICATED assignment ids so a repeat does not hash like a distinct member. THE DOMAIN MAY NOT WIDEN AFTER THE EVIDENCE IS CUT, and there are two forms. The lazy form leaves domain_sem_id behind and is caught by recomputing it. The COHERENT form moves the domain, its id and the expected count together, so every hash agrees and the bundle is a well-formed statement about eighty assignments carrying evidence for sixty-four -- and only the derived coverage refuses it. That is why the product is derived rather than compared. A THEOREM ABOUT TWO PROGRAMS MUST CHECK THAT THERE ARE TWO. If both sides of a case reach the same target_term_sem_id the case asserts that a program equals itself, and sixty-four of those still aggregate to VERIFIED. The two sides are required to DIFFER in target term and AGREE in decoded outcome, with the source evaluator agreeing independently as a third opinion that is not the referee. THE FILM IS THE ONE PART A CHECKER CANNOT RE-DERIVE, because it is a native execution, so it is REPLAYED -- on TWO RUNTIME CLASSES, one of them an allocator whose heap ids are non-monotone. That is where state.exec-identity@1's separation of execution identity from semantic identity is cashed rather than asserted: a readback inferring dependency order from an id integer fails here, in the artifact whose correctness depends on it, rather than silently years later. AND THE BOUND IS PART OF THE ARTIFACT, NOT PART OF A LEDGER SENTENCE. Sixty-four assignments verified exhaustively is not distributivity over the naturals; it is not an induction and nothing in it generalises past 3. A bundle whose scope record does not say so is making a different and larger claim, and the scope travels with the evidence because the evidence travels.
